problem_type: A shared Markdown renderer re-colored the upstream code-block chrome instead of owning its shape, so every fenced block rendered as nested cards with sideways scrolling and code typography regardless of content.
symptom: User report 2026-09-25 ("粘贴框设计有问题吧，为什么这么丑"): an Agent reply's English prompt under "英文版（如果用的模型更吃英文）：" sat in a bordered card with a large bordered copy pill, inside which a second bordered box held the text in a monospace font; the long line was cut off with a horizontal scrollbar. Reproduced in the real app by tests/ux/agent-code-block.walk.mjs on the pre-fix build: 3 bordered boxes per block, horizontal overflow 583-1709px, white-space: pre, ui-monospace for both prompts, copy chrome 38x34px (docs/evidence/2026-09-25-agent-panel-tidy/code-block-before.json).
direct_cause: src/workbench/common/NomiMarkdown.tsx gave Streamdown's code-block, code-block-body and copy button only color/radius tokens (`border-nomi-line`, `bg-nomi-ink-05`); Streamdown's own container border + p-2 + header row, bordered body with p-4, bordered/blurred action pill and `[&_pre]:overflow-x-auto` stayed in force, and `[&_pre]:font-nomi-mono` applied to every fence. The Shiki theme also painted the body with the same translucent ink-05, doubling the surface.
class_root: No layer decided what a fenced block is for. Models fence pasteable prose (prompts, copy) as often as code to get the copy button, but the renderer had a single code-only presentation and never looked at the fence language or content; the chrome itself was inherited from upstream defaults rather than owned by Nomi's one Markdown owner.
affected_population: Every model reply in the resident Agent panel (creation, canvas, preview, storyboard surfaces) that contains a fenced block
Every other NomiMarkdown consumer: prompt library preview, skill detail, canvas artifact body, updater release notes (LazyNomiMarkdown)
Both themes and both locales; Windows shows the horizontal scrollbar permanently
entry_points: Agent panel assistant messages and receipts via AgentPanelV4Markdown -> NomiMarkdown
Prompt library preview, skill detail, canvas artifact body and updater notes via NomiMarkdown / LazyNomiMarkdown

external_sources.purpose: Streamdown documents data-streamdown attribute selectors (code-block et al.) as the supported way to restyle its blocks; Nomi keeps using that hook instead of replacing the code renderer.

Installed streamdown 2.6.0 dist: the default `pre` component only clones its child with data-block, MarkdownCode forwards extra props to CodeBlock, and CodeBlock spreads them onto the code-block-body element; this is how data-nomi-code reaches the skin without a parallel renderer.

invariants: A fenced block renders exactly one bordered surface; lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways.
The copy control is a 24px ghost icon pinned to the container's top-right corner.
Typeface follows the fence: a language the highlighter recognises as code (other than markdown/plain text) stays monospace; otherwise the content decides, and pasteable prose uses the body typeface.

invariant_owner_layer.why: NomiMarkdown is the single Markdown owner every surface renders through; the skin and the pre adapter live there, and codeFenceTypeface is the one classification it consults, so no consumer can opt out or diverge.

door_reduction.why_not: The seven NomiMarkdown doors are readers of the one renderer, each a distinct surface (agent reply, prompt preview, skill doc, canvas artifact, release notes, the lazy wrapper, and the owner itself); the fix lives inside the owner they all share, so none of them needs to change or merge. The two new write doors are the typeface decision itself: codeFenceTypeface is called only by the NomiMarkdown pre adapter, and looksLikeCode only by codeFenceTypeface.

generality_proof: The skin and the typeface decision are applied inside NomiMarkdown, which door-map shows is the only Markdown renderer every surface uses; Streamdown's code path is untouched, so every fence from any model, provider, locale or surface gets one surface, wrapping, a small copy icon and a content-driven typeface.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Owns the code-block skin (single surface, wrap, corner copy icon) and tags each fence via the pre adapter.
Decides code vs prose from the fence language (via the highlighter's supportsLanguage) and, when that is silent, from the content.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Renders through NomiMarkdown profile agent-v4; tests/ux/agent-code-block.walk.mjs measures 1 bordered box, 0px overflow, sans prompts, mono JSON, 24x24 copy icon 5px from the corner in zh and en.
Uses the same NomiMarkdown component and className; agentPanelV4MarkdownKernel.test.ts D11b proves the fence tag is emitted by the shared renderer independent of profile.

Its own <pre> renders raw non-Markdown artifact files (technical text, not model fences); tool-input JSON pres in AgentPanelV4Receipt/Cards and error stacks are genuine code and keep their mono styling.

recurrence.reason: Any reply from any model that fences a prompt or long line hits the same renderer on every surface; the defect is structural, not tied to one message.
same_class_scan: door-map NomiMarkdown LazyNomiMarkdown: 7 read doors, all through the one owner

rg '<pre' src --glob '*.tsx': AgentPanelV4Cards/Receipt tool JSON, AiAssistedOnboardingCard MCP snippet, ErrorBoundary stack, ArtifactBody plain file, NodeErrorReport, ProvenancePanel - all technical text outside model fences
rg 'data-streamdown' src: only NomiMarkdown styles code blocks

prevention.invariant: Every fenced block rendered anywhere in Nomi goes through one skin and one typeface classifier.
prevention.failure_mode: An unrecognised or missing fence language falls back to the content heuristic; the heuristic defaults to prose only when no code signal (brackets, statement ends, keywords, operators, symbol density) is present.
prevention.strategy: Own the code-block chrome through Streamdown's documented data-streamdown hooks inside the single Markdown owner and tag each fence in the pre adapter, instead of per-surface styling.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old recolor-only skin (bordered body, bordered action pill, horizontal pre scrolling, unconditional mono, ink-05 Shiki background) is replaced in place; no second skin remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Streamdown 2.6.0 behaves as documented; Nomi now owns the presentation through the supported data-streamdown selectors and the standard pre component override, so no upgrade or patch is involved.

migration: Presentation only; no persisted data. Existing conversations re-render with the new skin.
residual_risks: The content heuristic is a judgement: an unfenced-language one-line shell command without code punctuation (e.g. `npm install foo`) renders in the body typeface; models normally tag those as bash.
The language header (e.g. `json`) is no longer shown; the copy icon replaces it as the only chrome.
Other NomiMarkdown surfaces (prompt preview, skill detail, artifact body, updater notes) were verified through the shared renderer test, not each walked in the real app.
